provenance.source_title: Your Life as a Bounty Hunter at Every Level

examples.psychological_goal: 用章节卡+年龄+工作三连定格小人物起点
examples.expression_mechanism: 层级章节卡+处境三连（21岁/夜班/加油站）
examples.example_text: Level one, the rookie. You are 21 years old. You work the night shift at a gas station.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「第X级+绰号」开场卡和一句年龄+工作的定格，零铺垫入场
examples.negative_instruction: 工作必须是最普通的底层工作，不可美化起点

examples.psychological_goal: 用一个物件动作把机会实体化
examples.expression_mechanism: 名片滑过柜台+失眠标记
examples.example_text: The card says bail enforcement. He tells you to come by his office on Monday. You don't sleep that night.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把人生转折压进一个小物件，用失眠标记它的重量
examples.negative_instruction: 物件必须具体（名片/一行字），不可写「他给了你一个机会」

examples.psychological_goal: 用导师的规则句给新人世界立规矩
examples.expression_mechanism: 导师规则句（人人撒谎/工作教真相）
examples.example_text: He says everyone lies on day one. He says the job teaches you the truth fast.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习让导师用两句对仗的规则句替行业发言
examples.negative_instruction: 规则句必须既是原谅也是警告，不可纯安慰

examples.psychological_goal: 一句话定性一门生意的荒诞地基
examples.expression_mechanism: 地基定性（建立在破碎承诺上的生意）
examples.example_text: It is a strange business built on broken promises.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「建立在X上的生意」一句话戳破行业底层逻辑
examples.negative_instruction: X必须正是这个机制的关键词（承诺/保释），不可泛化

examples.psychological_goal: 用失败率重构「坚持」的意义
examples.expression_mechanism: 失败率规则（失去多于抓到/退出者学不会）
examples.example_text: He says you will lose more men than you catch at first. He says the ones who quit never learn that lesson.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先把失败率说死，再把「不退出」定义为唯一护城河
examples.negative_instruction: 规则必须来自导师的口气，不可写成旁白说教

examples.psychological_goal: 用第一笔现金给命运定价
examples.expression_mechanism: 时薪震撼（2小时$800）
examples.example_text: $800 for 2 hours of work. You have never held that much cash at once.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用时薪换算+「从没拿过」的体感句写第一桶金
examples.negative_instruction: 金额与时长必须精确，不可用「不少钱」

examples.psychological_goal: 把行业核心技能从动作重定义为谜题
examples.expression_mechanism: 技能重定义（抓人谁都会，找人才是本事）
examples.example_text: Anyone can make an arrest. Not everyone can find the person to arrest.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「谁都会A，不是谁都会B」抬出真正的壁垒
examples.negative_instruction: B必须是观众之前没意识到的环节

examples.psychological_goal: 用悖论句点破追踪的方法论
examples.expression_mechanism: 悖论指路（人们总撒谎，但谎言会指路）
examples.example_text: People always lie on these forms. But the lies point somewhere.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「坏消息+但书」把障碍改写成线索
examples.negative_instruction: 但书必须立刻可操作（谎言指向哪），不可空泛乐观

examples.psychological_goal: 用同词对仗给行为模式下定律
examples.expression_mechanism: 同词对仗（改得了名字，改不了习惯）
examples.example_text: A man can change his name. A man cannot change his habits.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用can/cannot+同主语对仗，给人性下可操作的定律
examples.negative_instruction: 两个分句必须同一主语同一动词形式

examples.psychological_goal: 用比较级给「谈」胜过「打」定规矩
examples.expression_mechanism: 比较级规则（话比武力抓的人多）
examples.example_text: Words capture more men than force ever will.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用A capture more than B ever will的比较级给行业经验定型
examples.negative_instruction: 规则必须来自大量案例的口气，不可写成鸡汤

examples.psychological_goal: 用师徒对话完成衣钵交接
examples.expression_mechanism: 让功/归功对答（你建了自己/我只是开了门）
examples.example_text: He says no. He says you built yourself. He says he just opened the door.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「他说是你/他说不」的对答句完成导师退场与主题点题
examples.negative_instruction: 门必须与开场建立的门/名片意象呼应，不可孤立造喻

examples.psychological_goal: 让最亲的人说出最准的刀
examples.expression_mechanism: 亲人的判词+伤口比喻（爱追捕胜过爱她）
examples.example_text: She tells you that you love the chase more than you love her. The words cut deeper than any knife ever did.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习让家人用一句大白话完成控诉，再用职业内的伤口比喻记账
examples.negative_instruction: 伤口比喻必须与人物职业意象一致（刀），不可通用

examples.psychological_goal: 用否定句翻转职业的核心动作
examples.expression_mechanism: 动作翻转（等待才是工作，追捕不是）
examples.example_text: The waiting is the job now, not the chase.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「X才是工作，Y不是」翻转观众以为的核心动作
examples.negative_instruction: 翻转必须已被前文的等待场景证明，不可空翻

examples.psychological_goal: 给事业的暗价定下付款人
examples.expression_mechanism: 价码转移判词（付账的是你最爱的人）
examples.example_text: every capture has a price. And the price is being paid by the people you love most.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先说X有价码，再揭晓付款人不是你自己
examples.negative_instruction: 付款人必须已在叙事中持续受损（妻子/女儿），不可空降

examples.psychological_goal: 用数字对照结清得与失
examples.expression_mechanism: 得失对账（抓了几百个/失去仅有的两个）
examples.example_text: You have caught hundreds of fugitives. You have lost the only two people who ever mattered.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用大数成就对极小数损失，让「赢」自己翻车
examples.negative_instruction: 两项必须是同一计数单位（人），不可混用

examples.psychological_goal: 用时间对置写一段关系的完整弧
examples.expression_mechanism: 有无对置（一无所有时爱你/拥有一切时离开）
examples.example_text: Maria who loved you when you had nothing and left you when you had everything.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用when从句的对置把一段关系压成一句判词
examples.negative_instruction: 两个when必须正好互换（无/有），不可模糊

examples.psychological_goal: 用职业技能反写人生失败
examples.expression_mechanism: 技能反讽（找了一辈子人，找不到回女儿身边的路）
examples.example_text: You spent your whole life finding people who didn't want to be found.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先把职业技能总结到极致，为下一句「却找不到X」蓄力
examples.negative_instruction: 单独使用时必须是总结句，不可提前泄露反转对象

examples.psychological_goal: 用抢答写渴望的重量
examples.expression_mechanism: 抢答（话没说完就说了愿意）
examples.example_text: You say yes before she even finishes the sentence.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「没等说完就答应」的小动作写几十年的渴望
examples.negative_instruction: 前文必须已铺足等待（短信读40遍），抢答才有重量

examples.psychological_goal: 用职业动词完成主题回收
examples.expression_mechanism: 动词回收（追捕一辈子，终于抓到想要的）
examples.example_text: You spent your entire life hunting strangers and you finally caught the one thing you actually wanted.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用全片的核心动词（hunt/catch）在救赎句里最后一次变体
examples.negative_instruction: 抓到的东西必须是人/关系，不可落回事业成就

examples.psychological_goal: 用道具复制把结局接回开头
examples.expression_mechanism: 循环回收（穿背心的男人+一张名片+失眠）
examples.example_text: A man with a vest and a story will walk into his life and hand him a card. He will not sleep that night.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把开场的转折道具复制给一个新人物，让个案变成循环
examples.negative_instruction: 复制元素必须与开场一一对应（背心/名片/失眠），不可只写「还有别人」
